## 提交前 / Before review

- [ ] 保留显式调用与用户约束 / Explicit invocation and user constraints are preserved.
- [ ] 完成静态校验，或说明无法执行的原因 / Static validation ran, or the reason it could not run is explained.
- [ ] 同步相关文档、场景和变更记录；不适用时说明 / Relevant docs, scenarios, and changelog are updated, or marked not applicable.
- [ ] 已移除私人信息，并确认有权提交内容 / Private information is removed, and I have the right to contribute this content.
